---
title: "Co-occurrence network of microbial taxa"
output: html_document
params:
  data_dir: "downstream_input"   # folder with the abundance table and metadata file
  out_dir: "results/downstream"    # where network.graphml is written
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE)
dir.create(params$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Finds an input table: directly in params$data_dir, otherwise anywhere below it (the name must be unique there).
find_input <- function(name) {
  direct <- file.path(params$data_dir, name)
  if (file.exists(direct)) return(direct)
  found <- list.files(params$data_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  hits <- found[basename(found) == name]
  if (length(hits) == 1) return(hits)
  stop(if (length(hits) == 0) "Input file not found: " else "Input file name is not unique: ", name,
       " (searched in '", params$data_dir, "')", call. = FALSE)
}
```

## Input data

```{r input}
count <- read.csv(find_input("relative_abundance.csv"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv(find_input("metadata.csv"), header = T, row.names = 1)

dim(count)
dim(meta)

# the samples (columns) of the abundance table must match the metadata
stopifnot(identical(colnames(count), rownames(meta)))
```

## Network construction

The Jaccard similarity (1 - dissimilarity) between the rows of the abundance table is calculated, and the
`sparsity_percentile` percent most similar pairs are connected. The network is written as GraphML for Gephi or Cytoscape.

```{r network}
library(igraph) # For network analysis
library(vegan) # For calculating dissimilarity metrics
library(dplyr)

diss_matrix <- vegdist(count, method = "jaccard")
diss_matrix[is.na(diss_matrix)] <- 0
diss_matrix <- as.matrix(diss_matrix)
sim_matrix <- 1 - diss_matrix

sim_vector <- sim_matrix[lower.tri(sim_matrix)]
sorted_sim_vector <- sort(sim_vector, decreasing = TRUE)

sparsity_percentile <- 10
threshold <- quantile(sorted_sim_vector, 1 - sparsity_percentile / 100) # calculating threshold value
threshold

adj_matrix <- sim_matrix >= threshold

network <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_matrix, mode = "undirected")   # graph.adjacency() in older igraph versions
network

write_graph(network, file = file.path(params$out_dir, "network.graphml"), format = "graphml")
```
